scope.summary: One engine handles Latin, Cyrillic, Greek, Arabic, Hebrew, Indic, Southeast-Asian, and CJK with script-aware shaping, right-to-left and bidirectional runs, Kashida justification and diacritic positioning for Arabic/Hebrew, and CJK line-breaking (kinsoku) and inter-character spacing (mojikumi). There is NO separate world-ready build; complex-script support is always present (provenance PS unified text engine, AI RTL/Kashida + Asian composers, ID World-Ready + Japanese composers).
acceptance_criteria: single engine shapes Latin..CJK with bidi/Kashida/diacritics + kinsoku/mojikumi; always-on complex-script
expected_tests: live: Arabic/Hebrew RTL+bidi runs shape with Kashida + diacritic positioning
test: CJK kinsoku line-breaking + mojikumi spacing correctness

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Headless/backend MT: no operator-visible surface changed.

user_manual_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Non-product-behavior or internal-scaffold MT; UserManual updated by the consuming feature MT.

risk_if_missed: Non-Latin scripts mis-shape; international typography unmet.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
SQLite creep on a studio_* write path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
